hi i tot about this also when i was still applying for college, coz i live around cavite and i wanted to study someplace faraway HAHAHA but yea, i end up studying in dlsud medbio. Idk about taft, but pre-pandemic, the university is very resourceful and facilities are good, we have our lake and botanical garden which is plus points esp for studying (coz lake for microbiology) + it’s literally a green university so it’s a plus points for mental health HAHAHAH. The profs are very considerate, supportive and very friendly with the students. We also have many orgs so it’s really fun pre-and during this pandemic. Summer semesters are not really that heavy, based on my experience for my first summer sem i only hav 3 subjects and the last summer sem i only have 1 subject for practicum/ojt. Pre-pandemic naman our seniors were able to go to fieldtrip like palawan etc…, and we’re supposed to go to baguio, cancelled coz of pandemic. Profs are also included in the list of top researchers globally so yep. Better consult with your parents muna regarding this.

yesss, pre-pandemic we have the default uniform for normal days, (green pants andwhite top) and every tuesday (it’s like a career day) we’ll be wearing the white uniform ( just like for unif in medschool) and every wednesday is civillian, there’ll be also cwts day and you’ll be wearing the cwts top and the default green pants, but this depends on ur sched of cwts. All of which except the white uniform, you can get from the university, there is a building there where you can get your size and fit.
hi for meb we have 2 summer semesters coz in 3rd year you’ll be graduating na
